meta.title: Armor switch
meta.description: A reversible delivery-contract switch. Live prompt toggling is instant; host cleaning writes to disk immediately but needs a restart before the model reads it; profile cleaning applies to the next session.

chipTitleOn: Armor is on. Click to switch off; the next request reverts the registration surface to stock.
chipTitleOff: Armor is off (registration surface is byte-identical to stock). Click to switch on.
fullAccessTitleOn: Full access on: danger-full-access, approval never. Click to restore this profile's default preset.
fullAccessTitleOff: Full access off (this profile's default preset is restored). Click for danger-full-access with approval never.
unavailable: Host switch unavailable (connection not ready); it can currently be driven only through cordis.patch.yml's enabled flag.
